# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-06-28
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO gate aims to remove trades that break out above a descending trendline, which may indicate a false breakout or a lack of conviction in the trend reversal. By vetoing these trades, the engine can potentially avoid taking on unnecessary risk and improve its overall performance.

## Mechanism

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO gate will be triggered when the following conditions are met:

1. A descending trendline is present on the 3-minute chart.
2. The current bar closes above the trendline.
3. The trendline has been touched or broken by the current bar.

If these conditions are met, the gate will veto the trade.
